Template and schema inputs are hashed in Python after consuming the separate analysis JSON. The analysis does not include the template/schema fingerprints used for expansion. If another workflow modifies a template between the Node analysis and Python coverage phases, old expansion mechanics can be paired with fresh template hashes.
